style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 2.5m Pre Lit Outdoor Snowy Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Create a warm and welcome home this festive season with this snowy Christmas garland. At 2.5m in length and pre lit by 70 dual coloured LEDs, you can add a festive glow to your garden by choosing either white, warm white or a mixture of the two.</p><p>The garland features super realistic pine needles covered in a thick and elegant white faux snow, to create a full and luxurious Christmas garland that you can use for many years to come. </p><p>Style your garland over your front door or around your outdoor windows for a classic Christmas finish, and pair it with our snowy Christmas wreath and outdoor mini tree to transform your home into a winter wonderland. </p><p>To use, simply pop 3 x AA batteries into the battery box and choose the optional 6 hour timer function to light up your garland with an automatic glow at the same time each evening. Size : ONE</p>
